title: Kallaway stage plan
description: Per-reel graphic choices for the split shots of a Kallaway talking-head edit. Author this from the transcript. The closing split stays the lead-magnet document fan and is not listed here. Without a plan, the editor rotates motifs from a seed of the video path and does not repeat a motif on back-to-back split shots.

stages.description: One object per split shot you want to art-direct, in spoken order. Omit a shot and the seeded rotation fills it. A list of motif names is also accepted by the planner and means the same thing as stages with only a motif, applied in slot order.

spoken.description: A short phrase copied from stage_slots.spoken for the split shot this graphic illustrates. When any stage sets spoken or word_range, every stage must set one of them.

word_range.description: [start, end) indexes into the word list this timeline was planned against. The start word must fall inside a split shot.

why.description: Author note for the next editor. Not drawn on screen.

media.description: Local image or video for phone_frame, broll_card, or highlight_box. Absolute path, or a path relative to the plan file's directory when the runner loads it next to the timeline.

text.description: Sentence typed on screen for typing_ui.

heights.description: Bar heights as percentages for bar_chart.

pages.description: Not used on body shots. The closing doc_fan pages come from the theme.
